name: Suniti Kumar Chatterji
contribution: Suniti Kumar Chatterji was a major linguist who studied the history, structure, and regional varieties of Bengali and other South Asian languages.
context: Twentieth-century linguistics, Bengali literary scholarship, and debates over language and cultural identity.
impact: His research helped place Bengali within a comparative account of South Asian languages and shaped modern Bengali language scholarship.
highlight: Suniti Kumar Chatterji was one of the leading scholars of Bengali linguistics and language history.
seoTitle: Suniti Kumar Chatterji: Linguist of Bengali
seoDescription: Explore Suniti Kumar Chatterji's research on Bengali linguistics, language history, and South Asian language diversity.
shortAnswer: Suniti Kumar Chatterji was a Bengali linguist known for research on the history and structure of Bengali and South Asian languages.
